When to use it

Bind your vaults, shared configuration, and synchronization directions, then preview and verify. Author notes and vault lists are not included.

“Use this Skill for my task, first checking the companion methods and actual tools it needs.”

What is included

Includes the method and configuration guidance. The package README specifies resources, scripts, companion Skills, and external tools. Install relevant companions and bind your own environment.

Ask naturally; if the client supports explicit invocation, select obsidian-sync。The client’s existing authority, authentication, and tool boundaries remain in force.
